overview_description.description: Fractional is a social platform for fractional ownership of the real estate. The company develops an investment application to reduce the cost of entry and time commitment for property investing and also lets the users directly own fractions of investment properties and visualize the returns, cash flow, and costs of properties on the marketplace.

product.name: Fractional Platform
product.description: A software platform that facilitates fractional ownership and co-ownership of real estate investment properties by connecting individuals to invest together.

product.name: Accelerate Program
product.description: An invite-only accelerator program that offers mentorship, live deal reviews, and community support to help professionals improve their real estate investing skills and scale their investment projects.

product.name: Financial Account and Payment Services
product.description: Financial account management and payment processing services that handle funds for property investments, including deposits, distributions, and transfers, facilitated through partnerships with Stripe and Fifth Third Bank.
